    Indecomposable modules and fully faithful functors #

    isIndecomposable_iff: a module is indecomposable in the sense of Statement.IsIndecomposable (no decomposition into two nonzero submodules) if and only if it is nonzero and its only idempotent endomorphisms are 0 and 1. Consequently fully faithful functors between module categories that preserve zero morphisms preserve and reflect indecomposability (isIndecomposable_map_iff), and representation-finiteness can be pulled back along them (exists_list_of_isRepresentationFinite).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Reduction.isZero_iff_not_nontrivial {R : Type u} [Ring R] (M : ModuleCat R) :
    CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M ↔ ¬Nontrivial ↑M
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Reduction.isIndecomposable_iff {R : Type u} [Ring R] (M : ModuleCat R) :
    Statement.IsIndecomposable R ↑M ↔ ¬CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero M ∧ ∀ (f : M ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f f = f → f = 0 ∨ f = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id M

    Statement.IsIndecomposable S ↑(F.obj M) ↔ Statement.IsIndecomposable R ↑M

    ∃ (n : ℕ) (X : Fin n → ModuleCat S), ∀ (N : ModuleCat R) [Module.Finite R ↑N], Statement.IsIndecomposable R ↑N → ∃ (i : Fin n), Nonempty (F.obj N ≅ X i)

    Representation-finiteness of R gives finitely many objects of Mod S covering the images of finitely generated indecomposable R-modules under a functor F.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Reduction.isRepresentationFinite_of_two {S : Type u} [Ring S] {S₁ S₂ : Type u} [Ring S₁] [Ring S₂] (h₁ : Statement.IsRepresentationFinite S₁) (h₂ : Statement.IsRepresentationFinite S₂) (F₁ : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat S₁) (ModuleCat S)) (F₂ : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat S₂) (ModuleCat S)) [F₁.Full] [F₁.Faithful] [F₁.PreservesZeroMorphisms] [F₂.Full] [F₂.Faithful] [F₂.PreservesZeroMorphisms] (h : ∀ (M : ModuleCat S) [Module.Finite S ↑M], Statement.IsIndecomposable S ↑M → (∃ (N : ModuleCat S₁) (_ : Module.Finite S₁ ↑N), Nonempty (F₁.obj N ≅ M)) ∨ ∃ (N : ModuleCat S₂) (_ : Module.Finite S₂ ↑N), Nonempty (F₂.obj N ≅ M)) :
    Statement.IsRepresentationFinite S

    Representation-finiteness pulled back along two fully faithful functors whose images cover the finitely generated indecomposable modules.
